meta.name: Game of Thrones
meta.description: Seven noble families fight for control of the mythical land of Westeros. Friction between the houses leads to full-scale war. All while a very ancient evil awakens in the farthest north. Amidst the war, a neglected military order of misfits, the Night's Watch, is all that stands between the realms of men and icy horrors beyond.

videos.title: Winter Is Coming
videos.overview: Jon Arryn, the Hand of the King, is dead. King Robert Baratheon plans to ask his oldest friend, Eddard Stark, to take Jon's place. Across the sea, Viserys Targaryen plans to wed his sister to a nomadic warlord in exchange for an army.

videos.title: The Kingsroad
videos.overview: While Bran recovers from his fall, Ned takes only his daughters to Kings Landing. Jon Snow goes with his uncle Benjen to The Wall. Tyrion joins them.

videos.title: Lord Snow
videos.overview: Lord Stark and his daughters arrive at King's Landing to discover the intrigues of the king's realm.

videos.title: Cripples, Bastards, and Broken Things
videos.overview: Eddard investigates Jon Arryn's murder. Jon befriends Samwell Tarly, a coward who has come to join the Night's Watch.

videos.title: The Wolf and the Lion
videos.overview: Catelyn has captured Tyrion and plans to bring him to her sister, Lysa Arryn, at The Vale, to be tried for his, supposed, crimes against Bran. Robert plans to have Daenerys killed, but Eddard refuses to be a part of it and quits.

videos.title: A Golden Crown
videos.overview: While recovering from his battle with Jamie, Eddard is forced to run the kingdom while Robert goes hunting. Tyrion demands a trial by combat for his freedom. Viserys is losing his patience with Drogo.

videos.title: You Win or You Die
videos.overview: Robert has been injured while hunting and is dying. Jon and the others finally take their vows to the Night's Watch. A man, sent by Robert, is captured for trying to poison Daenerys. Furious, Drogo vows to attack the Seven Kingdoms.

videos.title: The Pointy End
videos.overview: Eddard and his men are betrayed and captured by the Lannisters. When word reaches Robb, he plans to go to war to rescue them. The White Walkers attack The Wall. Tyrion returns to his father with some new friends.

videos.title: Baelor
videos.overview: Robb goes to war against the Lannisters. Jon finds himself struggling on deciding if his place is with Robb or the Night's Watch. Drogo has fallen ill from a fresh battle wound. Daenerys is desperate to save him.

videos.title: Fire and Blood
videos.overview: With Ned dead, Robb vows to get revenge on the Lannisters. Jon must officially decide if his place is with Robb or the Night's Watch. Daenerys says her final goodbye to Drogo.

videos.title: The North Remembers
videos.overview: Tyrion arrives to save Joffrey's crown from threats old and new; Daenerys searches for allies and water in the Red Waste.

videos.title: The Night Lands
videos.overview: Arya shares a secret with a familiar recruit; a scout returns to Dany with disturbing news; Theon comes home to the Iron Islands.

videos.title: What Is Dead May Never Die
videos.overview: Tyrion roots out a spy; Catelyn meets a new king and queen; Bran dreams; Theon drowns.

videos.title: Garden of Bones
videos.overview: Catelyn tries to save two kings from themselves; Tyrion practices coercion; Robb meets a foreigner; Dany finds her ally.

videos.title: The Ghost of Harrenhal
videos.overview: The Baratheon rivalry ends; Tyrion learns of Cersei's secret weapon; Dany suffers a loss; Arya collects a debt she didn't know was owed.

videos.title: The Old Gods and the New
videos.overview: Arya has a surprise visitor; Dany vows to take what is hers; Joffrey meets his subjects; Qhorin gives Jon a chance to prove himself.

videos.title: A Man Without Honor
videos.overview: Jaime meets a distant relative; Dany receives an invitation; Theon leads a search party; Jon loses his way in the wilderness.

videos.title: The Prince of Winterfell
videos.overview: Theon holds down the fort; Arya calls in her debt with Jaqen; Robb is betrayed; Stannis and Davos approach their destination.

videos.title: Blackwater
videos.overview: Tyrion and the Lannisters fight for their lives as Stannis' fleet assaults King's Landing.

videos.title: Valar Morghulis
videos.overview: Tyrion wakes up in a new world; Dany goes to a strange place; Jon proves himself.

videos.title: Valar Dohaeris
videos.overview: Jon is tested by the wildling king; Tyrion asks for his reward; Dany sails to Slaver's Bay.

videos.title: Dark Wings, Dark Words
videos.overview: Sansa says too much. Shae asks Tyrion for a favor. Jaime finds a way to pass the time, while Arya encounters the Brotherhood Without Banners.

videos.title: Walk of Punishment
videos.overview: Tyrion shoulders new responsibilities. Jon is taken to the Fist of the First Men. Daenerys meets with the slavers. Jaime strikes a deal with his captors.

videos.title: And Now His Watch Is Ended
videos.overview: The Night's Watch takes stock. Varys meets his better. Arya is taken to the commander of the Brotherhood. Dany exchanges a chain for a whip.

videos.title: Kissed by Fire
videos.overview: The Hound is judged by the gods. Jaime is judged by men. Jon proves himself. Robb is betrayed. Tyrion learns the cost of weddings.

videos.title: The Climb
videos.overview: Four Houses consider make-or-break alliances. Jon and the Wildlings face a daunting climb.

videos.title: The Bear and the Maiden Fair
videos.overview: Dany exchanges gifts in Yunkai; Brienne faces a formidable foe in Harrenhal.

videos.title: Second Sons
videos.overview: Dany meets the Titan's Bastard; King's Landing hosts a royal wedding.

videos.title: The Rains of Castamere
videos.overview: House Frey joins forces with House Tully. Jon faces his most difficult test yet.

videos.title: Mhysa
videos.overview: Joffrey challenges Tywin. Dany waits to see if she is a conqueror or a liberator.

videos.title: Two Swords
videos.overview: King's Landing prepares for a royal wedding; Dany finds the way to Meereen; the Night's Watch braces for a new threat.

videos.title: The Lion and the Rose
videos.overview: The Lannisters and their guests gather in King's Landing; Stannis loses patience with Davos; Ramsay finds a purpose for his pet.

videos.title: Breaker of Chains
videos.overview: Tyrion ponders his options; Tywin extends an olive branch; Jon proposes a bold plan; The Hound teaches Arya the way thing are.

videos.title: Oathkeeper
videos.overview: Dany balances justice and mercy; Jaime tasks Brienne with his honor; Jon readies his men.

videos.title: First of His Name
videos.overview: Cersei and Tywin plot the Crown's next move. Dany discusses future plans. Jon Snow embarks on a new mission.

videos.title: The Laws of Gods and Men
videos.overview: Stannis and Davos set sail with a new strategy. Dany meets with supplicants. Tyrion faces down his father in the Throne Room.

videos.title: Mockingbird
videos.overview: Tyrion enlists an unlikely ally. Daario entreats Dany to allow him to do what he does best. Jon's warnings fall on deaf ears.

videos.title: The Mountain and the Viper
videos.overview: Mole's Town receives some unexpected visitors. Littlefinger's motives are questioned. Tyrion's fate is decided.

videos.title: The Watchers on the Wall
videos.overview: Jon Snow and the rest of the Night's Watch face the biggest challenge to the Wall yet.

videos.title: The Children
videos.overview: Circumstances change after an unexpected arrival from north of the Wall. Dany must face harsh realities. Bran learns more about his destiny. Tyrion sees the truth about his situation.

videos.title: The Wars to Come
videos.overview: Cersei and Jaime adjust to a world without Tywin. Varys reveals a conspiracy to Tyrion. Dany faces a new threat to her rule. Jon is caught between two kings.

videos.title: The House of Black and White
videos.overview: Arya arrives in Braavos. Podrick and Brienne run into trouble on the road. Cersei fears for her daughter's safety in Dorne as Ellaria Sand seeks revenge for Oberyn's death. Stannis tempts Jon. An adviser tempts Daenerys.

videos.title: High Sparrow
videos.overview: In Braavos, Arya sees the Many-Faced God. In King's Landing, Queen Margaery enjoys her new husband. Tyrion and Varys walk the Long Bridge of Volantis.

videos.title: Sons of the Harpy
videos.overview: The Faith Militant grow increasingly aggressive. Jaime and Bronn head south. Ellaria and the Sand Snakes vow vengeance.

videos.title: Kill the Boy
videos.overview: Dany makes a difficult decision in Meereen. Jon recruits the help of an unexpected ally. Brienne searches for Sansa. Theon remains under Ramsay's control.

videos.title: Unbowed, Unbent, Unbroken
videos.overview: Arya trains. Jorah and Tyrion run into slavers. Trystane and Myrcella make plans. Jaime and Bronn reach their destination. The Sand Snakes attack.

videos.title: The Gift
videos.overview: Jon prepares for conflict. Sansa tries to talk to Theon. Brienne waits for a sign. Stannis remains stubborn. Jaime attempts to reconnect with family.

videos.title: Hardhome
videos.overview: Arya makes progress in her training. Sansa confronts an old friend. Cersei struggles. Jon travels.

videos.title: The Dance of Dragons
videos.overview: Stannis confronts a troubling decision. Jon returns to The Wall. Mace visits the Iron Bank. Arya encounters someone from her past. Dany reluctantly oversees a traditional celebration of athleticism.

videos.title: Mother's Mercy
videos.overview: Stannis marches. Dany is surrounded by strangers. Cersei seeks forgiveness. Jon is challenged.

videos.title: The Red Woman
videos.overview: The fate of Jon Snow is revealed. Daenerys meets a strong man. Cersei sees her daughter once again.

videos.title: Home
videos.overview: Bran trains with the Three-Eyed Raven. In King’s Landing, Jaime advises Tommen. Tyrion demands good news, but has to make his own. At Castle Black, the Night’s Watch stands behind Thorne. Ramsay Bolton proposes a plan, and Balon Greyjoy entertains other proposals.

videos.title: Oathbreaker
videos.overview: Daenerys meets her future. Arya trains to be No One.

videos.title: Book of the Stranger
videos.overview: Tyrion strikes a deal. Jorah and Daario undertake a difficult task. Jaime and Cersei try to improve their situation.

videos.title: The Door
videos.overview: Tyrion seeks a strange ally. Bran learns a great deal. Brienne goes on a mission. Arya is given a chance to prove herself.

videos.title: Blood of My Blood
videos.overview: An old foe comes back into the picture. Gilly meets Sam's family. Arya faces a difficult choice. Jaime faces off against the High Sparrow.

videos.title: The Broken Man
videos.overview: The High Sparrow eyes another target. Jaime confronts a hero. Arya makes a plan. The North is reminded.

videos.title: No One
videos.overview: While Jaime weighs his options, Cersei answers a request. Tyrion's plans bear fruit. Arya faces a new test.

videos.title: Battle of the Bastards
videos.overview: Slaver envoys demand terms of surrender in Meereen. Ramsay plays the odds in defense of Winterfell.

videos.title: The Winds of Winter
videos.overview: Cersei faces a day of reckoning. Daenerys antes up for the 'Great Game'.

videos.title: Dragonstone
videos.overview: Jon Snow organizes the defense of the North. Cersei tries to even the odds. Daenerys comes home.

videos.title: Stormborn
videos.overview: Daenerys receives an unexpected visitor. Jon faces a revolt. Sam risks his career and life. Tyrion plans the conquest of Westeros.

videos.title: The Queen's Justice
videos.overview: Daenerys holds court. Tyrion backchannels. Cersei returns a gift. Jaime learns from his mistakes.

videos.title: The Spoils of War
videos.overview: The Lannisters pay their debts. Daenerys weighs her options. Arya comes home.

videos.title: Eastwatch
videos.overview: Daenerys offers a choice. Arya grows suspicious. Tyrion answers a good question.

videos.title: Beyond the Wall
videos.overview: Jon and the Brotherhood hunt the dead. Arya confronts Sansa. Tyrion thinks about the future.

videos.title: The Dragon and the Wolf
videos.overview: Tyrion tries to save Westeros from itself. Sansa questions loyalties.

videos.title: Winterfell
videos.overview: Arriving at Winterfell, Jon and Daenerys struggle to unite a divided North. Jon Snow gets some big news.

videos.title: A Knight of the Seven Kingdoms
videos.overview: The battle at Winterfell is approaching. Jaime is confronted with the consequences of the past. A tense interaction between Sansa and Daenerys follows.

videos.title: The Long Night
videos.overview: The Night King and his army have arrived at Winterfell and the great battle begins. Arya looks to prove her worth as a fighter.

videos.title: The Last of the Starks
videos.overview: In the wake of a costly victory, Jon and Daenerys look to the south as Tyrion eyes a compromise that could save countless lives.

videos.title: The Bells
videos.overview: Daenerys brings her forces to King's Landing.

videos.title: The Iron Throne
videos.overview: In the aftermath of the devastating attack on King's Landing, Daenerys must face the survivors.
